title: Building a Crypto Store on Cloudflare Pages: A Step-by-Step Deployment Guide — No Stripe Required
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Stack 01 or Stack 02. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. NOWPayments throughout. Deployed in 48 hours. Owned by you.

content.text: Zimbabwean digital creators, you're no strangers to financial isolation. You can't use Stripe or PayPal, making it impossible to sell your ebooks, courses, and digital products to the world. The platforms that were supposed to help you succeed are now barriers to entry. But there's a solution. A sovereign commerce infrastructure that puts you in control. No more renting infrastructure, no more subscriptions, no more reliance on platforms that can shut down at any moment. It's time to build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, and in this guide, we'll show you how to do it. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you'll have a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. You'll own your infrastructure, and you'll have the freedom to create, to sell, and to scale on your own terms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The reason this infrastructure works when platforms fail is that it's built on open-source technology that you own and control. You're not renting a platform, you're deploying a sovereign commerce stack that's hosted on Cloudflare Pages. This means you have complete control over your infrastructure, and you can scale it to meet your needs without relying on third-party services. When platforms like Stripe or PayPal shut down, your infrastructure won't be affected because it's not tied to their ecosystem. You can continue to sell your digital products, process payments, and deliver products to your customers without interruption.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need a few things. First, you'll need a Cloudflare account, which is free. You'll also need to set up a GitHub account to store your code. Additionally, you'll need to obtain a digital wallet that supports your preferred cryptocurrency. Finally, you'll need to purchase the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes everything you need to get started, from the Cloudflare Pages hosting to the NOWPayments integration.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages store. This involves setting up a webhook that fires the moment a payment is confirmed on-chain. You'll also need to configure your delivery pipeline to automatically send products to your customers once payment has been received. This process is straightforward, and the Edge Commerce Stack includes detailed documentation and guides to help you every step of the way.
Cloudflare Pages provides a free and scalable hosting solution for your crypto store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live. This involves deploying your store to Cloudflare Pages and making it available to the public. To process your first transaction, simply create a product, set a price, and make it available for sale. When a customer purchases your product, the payment will be processed automatically, and the product will be delivered to their digital wallet.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your crypto store once it's up and running is a matter of configuring your infrastructure to meet your needs. This involves setting up load balancing, caching, and other performance optimization techniques to ensure that your store can handle a high volume of traffic. The Edge Commerce Stack includes guides and documentation to help you scale your infrastructure, and you can also reach out to Cloudflare's support team for additional assistance.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages with your product pages and checkout flow pointing to the backend. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires to your backend, confirm the order appears in your database, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Only after the complete pipeline test passes should you make the store URL public. COREMERCH runs this complete test before handoff on every deployment.
The Edge Commerce Stack includes a full suite of tools and services to help you build, manage, and scale your store.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on how to build a sovereign commerce infrastructure, check out our other resources, including the complete builder kit and the sovereign startup guide. The Edge Commerce Stack is also part of a larger ecosystem of tools and services that help you build, manage, and scale your crypto store.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: Create a Cloudflare account and sign up for the Edge Commerce Stack. Set up a GitHub account and store your code. Obtain a digital wallet that supports your preferred cryptocurrency. Configure your payment and delivery pipeline by integrating NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages store. Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages and make it available to the public. Create a product, set a price, and make it available for sale. Test your store and ensure that payments are processing correctly.
With NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies and process payments automatically.
